result:
The fix round for all 20 F4 defects is committed on `v2/f4` (now at `59d383b`). `server/test_flow.py` prints "all good", and the new `server/checks/f4.py`, `python3 server/estimate.py` and `python3 server/ratings.py` pass. A short smoke test on port 8014 worked; I stopped the server after.

**Branch — needs action.** `v2/f4` is checked out in the old worktree `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/.claude/worktrees/f4`, and the harness wouldn't let me work there. I worked on a detached HEAD in my worktree, then moved the branch with `git update-ref refs/heads/v2/f4 59d383b d5961bb`, which only succeeds if the branch was still at `d5961bb`. That old worktree's files still match `d5961bb`, so `git status` there will show my commits as uncommitted reverts. Don't commit anything from it. Reset it with `git checkout -f v2/f4`, or detach it, before anyone uses it.

**What changed, by commit:**
- `6aee941` `scoring.py`: `accepted_forms` now fits the grid (2/3 → 2/3, .6666, .6667, 0.666, 0.667; 7/3 → 7/3, 2.333). Adds `entry_error` and `grid_diagnose`.
  - `satdates.py`: registration, late and score dates from College Board's pages.
  - `server/data/cb_percentiles.json`: College Board's SAT User percentiles as printed. The page gives no year, so `year` says "past three graduating classes". The values are a web-fetch transcription that I spot-checked against the page.
- `30a6b8f` `deps.py`:
  - `access()` protects every date that is still today somewhere, twin challenge and contest sittings, and live contest items. It reveals pairs on finished papers.
  - `key_printed`, `subject_of`, `subject_param` (422 for an unknown subject), `writer_of` (403 for `sample:` writes).
  - `learner_of` resolves `d:` device tokens and serves an `a:` code inside its 14-day swap window. A retired code gets 401 on every request, as U21 specifies.
- `176f90f` `db.py`, `ratings.py`, `tools/seed_ratings.py`:
  - Every upgrade table, column and index, with backfills for `offered`, `trap_log`, board handles and ratings.
  - `NOT_SAMPLE`, and `LEARNER_TABLES` as a table → WHERE-clause map that now includes sets, contests, name_reports and the plan child tables.
  - Item and skill ratings (P11/C13); every level L1–L7 holds at least 5% of question types.
- `6a171ce` `progress.py`:
  - A named trap now drops `owed` only when the question offered it; unsure, filler-slip and unnamed grid-in traps keep the old rule.
  - Transfer check-ins close with `closed_how='transfer'`. A miss on a due check-in, or taking the trap in a trap test, reopens it as Relapsed.
  - The clean rule counts hints and unsure; `repeat` now comes from `access()`; `record_trap` is split out; ranked, unvoided contest answers call `compete.rate`.
  - `carry` keeps the side with more rated answers, archives the other active plan and un-ranks repeat contest sittings.
  - `days()` caps each module separately, and each day row adds practice, tests, the day's questions and spare days.
  - New readers: warm-up, forecast, rechecks, causes, pace, recovery, calibration, types met, steps to Strong, `conf_active`, `remark`, `discard`/`restore`. `coach` returns reasons; `board` returns evidence, 14-day trend and the last five answers.
- `09804ea` `prefs.py`: every upgrade key, mode and stage bundles with `pref_source`, `{key: null}` to delete, `MODE_SOURCES`, and the registry for `GET /api/prefs`.
- `c1ce5b8` `estimate.py`: percentiles rank each learner's first ranked sitting of the same kind (papers by `mock_id`, modules included). Adds exact re-marking (`mid`, `rescore`, `ledger`, `rescore_sitting`) and the U4 practice model (`gains`, `need`, `route`, `time_cost`, `practice_delta`). Also adds `projection`, `total`, `national`, `growth` and `calibration`.
- `22a8c8f` `api_me.py`, `api_notes.py`:
  - `/api/me` adds `account`, `pref_source`, `stage`, the registration line and `review.due_left`.
  - Private name (any script) split from a unique board handle; `GET /api/prefs`.
  - Notes: empty values delete the row, `attempt_id` is accepted, type rules are stored at seed −1.
- `59d383b` `checks/f4.py`: checks for all of the above.

`6a171ce` also changes the one `server/test_flow.py` assertion that encoded the old "any two clean answers close it" rule. The spec lets a task edit an assert its change breaks, in the smallest hunk. It now expects the trap to close only when the questions offered it.

**Needs other owners:**
- **`app.py` (F0/I1):** add `app.middleware("http")(deps.swap_middleware)`. Without it no `X-Learner-Swap` header is sent and no swap device is created.
- **F5, `drill.py`:**
  - The trap-seeking seed search for repairs and the redo and check-in pools, using `progress.checkin_template`. Until it exists, repairs often don't offer the trap, so traps close slowly.
  - Pass conf, hints, struck, cover, calc, source and placement to `record`, and use `prefs.for_source`.
  - Store per-question odds on drill questions.
- **S5:** set `sessions.ranked`, `unranked_why` and `subject` at finish. `record_paper` already writes `result.odds` and reads `qstate`.
- **S8:** `compete.rate(learner, sid, q, correct, when)` — I chose this signature because the spec gives none.
- **S10:** `review.due(learner, tz)["left"]` feeds `due_left` once it exists; the void/unvoid endpoints call `progress.discard` and `progress.restore`.
- **Section endpoints:** call `deps.subject_param`.
- **README:** the F4 subsection isn't updated; that file isn't in my list.

On your "give it vocab now": that Words handoff is another agent's task. This round only added the vocab-side data F4 owns: `attempts.word`, the word columns and tables, R&W answers filed as ordinary attempts, and the Words preferences.
